messages:
Alex N: taking the 8pm->8am overnight shift. leaving notes on coverage gaps and escalation logic so whoever picks up can reference quickly. primary = Alex N, secondary = Maya R, SRE lead = Tom S. if both primary+secondary are unreachable, page the rotation lead (see rota).

Maya R: ack. I’ll be on-call backup and reachable via mobile. ETA for me to respond is usually <15m unless I'm in a deploy.

Tom S: FYI I’m on light pager tonight but OOO from 02:00-04:00 for a planned window — I can still be escalated if needed. If you see sustained 5xxs or memory OOM on runtime, escalate to me ASAP.

Jen C: Support Pager here — we already have 2 tickets flagged by enterprise customers about slow responses from embedding endpoints in EU. Not yet a full incident but trending. I'll drop the customer IDs in the support tracker.

Alex N: thanks Jen. note on customer impact assessment: if >3 distinct customers reporting degraded latency or any single enterprise customer reports degraded correctness or data loss, escalate to "eng-ops" channel + notify assigned AM/AE. Use the template in the runbook.

incident-bot: Incident rules reminder — page oncall when: 
• p95 latency > 1.5s for >10m across a region OR
• error rate > 2% for >5m OR
• any confirmed data integrity issue.

Maya R: adding a short checklist for whoever takes over. paste into handoff message and check off: 
```
Handoff checklist:
- Confirm rota shows primary/secondary (https://redwood.internal/rota)
- Verify pagers are attached and alerts test passed (ops->alerts->test)
- Check live telemetry: latency, error-rate, queue depth
- Pause/rollback any in-progress canaries for risky models
- Confirm KV cache warm status for large customers (run: /scripts/check_cache.sh <customer>)
- Notify PM/AM if customer impact threshold met
```

Alex N: also FYI there's a known capacity gap in us-west-2 between 23:00-01:00 due to a planned autoscaler tweak. Ops infra has a mitigation but please watch routing fallback: model routing may fallback to smaller variants which increases latency; if that happens, follow Escalation path B below.

Tom S: Escalation paths (quick):
- Path A (service degradation, non-data-loss): page oncall -> if no ack in 10m page secondary -> if no resolution in 30m escalate to SRE lead (Tom S) and open an incident channel.
- Path B (high customer impact e.g., enterprise SLA breach, data loss): page oncall immediately, page SRE lead, page oncall@secops, notify Support Pager and AE/AM, and open incident channel with bridge.

Jen C: do we have a quick message template to send to customers? saves time.

Alex N: yes, use the support template under /docs/customer-comms/latency-template.md. Short version: we acknowledge, investigating, ETA 30-60m, will update hourly. Only update more frequently if we have a clear mitigation.

ops-bot: Reminder: nightly batch job "model-weights-sync" scheduled 23:40 UTC. It can increase IO and trigger transient 502s on internal model-puller; consider disabling if you see correlated 502 spikes.

Maya R: practical notes for handoff message at 20:00: include current alert state, active deploys, any throttled customers, and link to open support tickets. If you leave a TODO for the next shift, mark priority and expected owner.

Alex N: leaving a short live summary for my handoff: no active incidents, small EU latency spike (~p95 1.2s) trending up, 2 support tickets (IDs: SUP-1147, SUP-1150) assigned to Jen. Autoscaler tweak window 23:00-01:00 in us-west-2. Secondary is Maya. Logs + traces: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/trace?span=1779056789

Maya R: I'll take the handoff at 20:00. If anything pops, page me first then Tom.

Alex N: thanks — leaving my mobile in the handoff: +1-555-0147. If anyone needs me for data-loss escalation, call me immediately. Good luck and ping me in this thread if you want me to leave anything else before I sign out. :thumbsup:

Tom S: thumbs up. Keeping an eye on the autoscaler window.

Jen C: copying the comms template into the ticket now.

incident-bot: Handoff registered by Alex N at 19:55. Next handoff scheduled at 07:55 UTC.

Maya R: handoff acknowledged.

Support Pager: monitoring: will page #eng-oncall for any customer escalations and will notify AMs as required.

Alex N: signing off now. night all.
